role: single machine-readable source for the ontology-private documentation preset: category set and per-kind placement vocabulary. Shipped inside the skill next to the scripts; a sibling resolve (not CWD, not repo root). The two Markdown tables (governance-contract.md Categories, kind-templates.md doc-kind rows) are pointers to this file, not human mirrors. This is ontology-private semantic payload — distinct from the shared cross-skill core in docs/skill-conventions/.

provenance.note: Migrated verbatim from the two Markdown tables (governance-contract.md Categories rows and kind-templates.md 17 doc-kind rows). Content moved, not derived from any governed repository artifact; no seeded baseline. This file is the normative source from now on; the Markdown tables point here.

categories.notes: ontology is the ZAgentic-local ontology home (long-lived but repo-specific); other repos may not carry it. Permitted divergence is reported as signal (PRESET_DIVERGENCE), not a vocabulary violation.

method.job: How to perform one repeated piece of work: steps, usage, current behavior
method.does_not_belong: Why it is done this way (a design or adr claims that), and records of one particular run (process material)
method.must_write_sections: Purpose / When to use / Steps / Verification / Ownership
method.focused_check: Every command, flag and default value has actually been run

prd.job: What problem one capability solves, its goals and its non-goals
prd.does_not_belong: Implementation detail (design), and usage instructions after it ships (method or reference)
prd.must_write_sections: Problem / Goals / Non-goals / Scope / Open questions
prd.focused_check: Non-goals is non-empty and names something someone will ask for

architecture-map.job: The index: which page owns which bounded question
architecture-map.does_not_belong: Any body content — it holds pointers, never prose
architecture-map.focused_check: One authority-id is bound to exactly one page

architecture-overview.job: What the system is: boundary, main parts, and how they relate
architecture-overview.focused_check: Every component links to the descendant that owns it

architecture-layers.job: Layer responsibilities and the allowed direction of dependency
architecture-layers.focused_check: Dependency direction is stated once and is one-way

architecture-subsystem.job: One subsystem's purpose, responsibility and high-level behavior
architecture-subsystem.does_not_belong: Low-level implementation detail (link to the owning descendant) and cross-part sequences (architecture-flow)
architecture-subsystem.focused_check: No section explains something a descendant already owns

architecture-flow.job: One sequence that crosses parts: control or data, in order, with failure
architecture-flow.does_not_belong: Static responsibility of the participants (that is architecture-subsystem or architecture-overview)
architecture-flow.must_write_sections: Actors / Steps / Failure and retry / Boundaries
architecture-flow.focused_check: Every step names an owner and a failure path

architecture-cross-cutting.job: One concern that applies everywhere: logging, security, configuration, errors
architecture-cross-cutting.does_not_belong: A single component's own explanation of that concern
architecture-cross-cutting.focused_check: Every exception is named rather than implied

agreement.job: What two or more parties owe each other: interface contracts, commitments, limits
agreement.does_not_belong: One party's internal decision (that is adr or design)
agreement.focused_check: Change process says who has to agree

design.job: Why one option was chosen: options considered, trade-offs, consequences
design.does_not_belong: Usage steps (method) and, once built, the description of what now exists (architecture-*)
design.focused_check: At least two rejected alternatives, each with a reason

testing.job: Test strategy: levels, how to run them, what fixtures pin
testing.does_not_belong: The result of one run — that is an evidence surface, not a page
testing.must_write_sections: Levels / How to run / Fixtures / Coverage expectations
testing.focused_check: Every command in it has been run

benchmark.job: The definition of a measurement and the conditions that make two runs comparable
benchmark.does_not_belong: Raw profiles and any single run's numbers (evidence surface)
benchmark.must_write_sections: Workload / Method / Environment / How to reproduce
benchmark.focused_check: Environment is stated precisely enough to reproduce

reference.job: The lookup surface for external or current facts: APIs, configuration, specifications
reference.does_not_belong: A teaching sequence (method), and arguments for a position (design or adr)
reference.must_write_sections: Lookup scope / Current behavior / Version pin / Source
reference.focused_check: Every fact carries a source, a version pin, or both

adr.job: One long-lived decision: its verdict and its reasons
adr.does_not_belong: How the decision was executed (process material), and the state of the world after it (architecture-*)
adr.focused_check: An implemented decision is written in the present tense about reality

plan.job: Work in progress: scope, steps, and the next checkpoint
plan.does_not_belong: Conclusions after the work ends (process closeout), and anything durable (method, architecture-*)
plan.focused_check: There is a stated end condition, not just a task list

retro.job: What one piece of finished work produced: findings and next actions
retro.does_not_belong: Work still in motion (plan), and general practice (method)
retro.focused_check: Findings are separated from next actions

fixture-documentation.job: Why one fixture exists and which invariant it pins
fixture-documentation.does_not_belong: The fixture's own data and results (evidence surface)
fixture-documentation.must_write_sections: What it pins / Why / How to regenerate
fixture-documentation.focused_check: It names the invariant, not just the files
